propositions: Implement read-only derivations over gate sidecars to compute llm_calls and latency metrics sourced exclusively from REVIEW_RESULT.metrics (never from COMPLETION_VERDICT which carries no metrics block).

Calculate cost_per_accepted_change as the sum of llm_calls across REVIEW_RESULT records divided by the count of completion_verifier_pass_v1 records (accepted closes), returning None when zero accepted closes exist.
Compute first_pass_verification as the fraction of tickets whose earliest (oldest-first chronological order) COMPLETION_VERDICT record is a completion_verifier_pass_v1.

Pair each gate_error_v1 ERROR record with the next same-gate PASS record (matching on the ERROR's gate field against subsequent REVIEW_RESULT or COMPLETION_VERDICT passes) and compute env_diagnosis_interval as the timestamp delta; unresolved ERRORs without a matching PASS yield open intervals.

Raw scan per-ticket *-REVIEW_RESULT.json and *-COMPLETION_VERDICT.json event files in chronological order by filename prefix / event_sort_key, reading data.schema and data.verdict to identify record types without using reducer-ignored schema helpers.
Register all metrics into src/rebar/metrics/registry.py with source='sidecar' (authoritative) and confidence='high'.
